title: The Sign on the Blue Truck
synopsis: A compact loader brings gravel to prepared supports while Dan delivers the framed picture map with his liftgate. Mr. Lee and Aunt Jo oversee the installation beside the existing Pine Park sign.
continuity_state: Before: The picture map has been checked against the town's established geography, and Mr. Lee's adult crew has planned and prepared its location outside the Pine Park walking path; no board has yet been installed. After: The compact loader uses the existing northern service lane, Dan's blue box truck delivers the framed map, and the adult team mounts it beside the old Pine Park sign without moving the rain gauge or blocking the park gate. The new clear-covered picture board is available to visitors; work area reopened.

rationale_citations.story_anchor: The small loader had four wheels and a broad bucket in front. It carried a modest scoop of gravel.
rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: Compact wheel loaders use front buckets to lift and carry loose material; exact machine model and amount are fictional.

rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: Truck liftgates are used to raise and lower materials between cargo floor level and unloading height.
